definitions.name: O3D.DEPTH
definitions.body: CHARS [ 'O3D.C' BIND [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD O3D.C GET ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> greatest nesting depth (max of running open-count, 0 for empty)

definitions.name: O3D.BALANCED-PREFIX
definitions.body: G0A.BSCAN 'O3D.B' BIND O3D.B O1A.IDX [ 'O3D.I' BIND O3D.I 1 ADD 0 O3D.B O3D.I GET '#' EQ SELECT ] MAP 0 [ MAX ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String -> length of the longest balanced prefix (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: O3D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'O3D.V' BIND O3D.V O3D.V O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ G0B.FILLSTEP ] SCAN
definitions.note: V with NILs -> forward-filled V, leading NILs taking the first present value

definitions.name: O3D.GAP-COUNT
definitions.note: V with NILs -> number of runs of consecutive NILs

definitions.name: O3D.PRESENT-MEAN
definitions.note: V with NILs (at least one present) -> exact mean of the present elements

definitions.name: O3D.REPORT
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> revenue (qty*price over priced orders) as a String with two decimals

definitions.name: O3D.UNPRICED
definitions.body: [ 'price' HAS? NOT ] FILTER [ 'sku' GET ] MAP UNIQUE
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> distinct skus of the orders without a price, in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O3D.TAG-COUNTS
definitions.body: [ 'tags' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'tags' GET UNIQUE ] MAP [ ] [ CONCAT ] FOLD TALLY
definitions.note: Vector of order Records -> Record from each tag to the number of orders carrying it, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O3D.LWORDS
definitions.note: messy space-separated String -> Vector of its words in lower case, in order

definitions.name: O3D.NORMALIZE
definitions.note: messy String -> lower-case words joined by single spaces, trimmed

definitions.name: O3D.DISTINCT
definitions.note: messy String -> number of distinct words ignoring case

definitions.name: O3D.TOP-WORD
definitions.note: messy String -> most frequent word (lower case), first-appearing on ties

definitions.name: O3D.TITLE
definitions.note: messy String -> words title-cased, joined by single spaces

definitions.name: O3D.SORTED-UNIQUE
definitions.note: messy String -> distinct lower-case words in alphabetical order, joined by single spaces
